## About Alishe Nails
Alishe Nails is a luxury handmade press-on nail atelier based in Karachi, Pakistan. 
We specialize in 7-layer salon gel press-on nails that are 100% damage-free, reusable up to 5 times, 
and delivered in signature luxury packaging across Karachi.

## Product Categories
- **Everyday Elegance**: Natural, daily-wear press-on sets
- **Bridal Collection**: Elaborate designs for weddings and formal events
- **Soft Glam**: Subtle, elegant styles for everyday sophistication
- **Bold & Chic**: Statement-making designs with unique finishes
- **Luxury Edition**: Premium, high-end nail art collections

## Key Features
- 7-layer salon gel structure for long-lasting wear (up to 3+ weeks)
- Zero natural nail damage - safe 10-minute application & gentle warm-water soak off
- Custom millimeter measurements or standard XS-L sizes
- Doorstep delivery in 48-96 hours across all Karachi zones
- 100% damage-free, reusable up to 5 times
- Complimentary prep kit with every order

## Shipping & Delivery
- Coverage: Clifton, DHA, Gulshan, PECHS, and all Karachi zones
- Delivery time: 48-96 hours doorstep
- Payment methods: SadaPay, JazzCash, Instagram/SDA payments
- Orders require advance payment confirmation
